page.overview:
Who is Shelke?

Shelke is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. She is a Grymoirian incarnation of Shelke Rui originating from Dirge of Cerberus -Final Fantasy VII-. Shelke is one of the five character representatives of the Final Fantasy VII series, the other four being Cloud, Tifa, Sephiroth, and Zack (the latter appearing only in the Maxima version).

Shelke is fought as a boss in an unwinnable battle in the Underground Prison at the beginning of Chapter 15, "The Mako Reactor and the Black Mages".

Shelke accompanies the twins at the beginning of Chapter 15 after neutralizing their suppressors and follows them into Mako Reactor 0 to restore power to Figaro Castle. As with most Grymorian versions of main characters from the Final Fantasy series, Shelke does not participate in battles, only simply accompanying the twins on the field. She leaves the party after the chapter has been cleared.

The player controls Shelke as a game piece in the Sandstalker minigame. She possesses two hit points, while Terra and Vivi have three and one, respectively.
